shell_commands: cat AGENTS.md | grep -A 30 "Spec Test Links\|validated by\|require-spec-link" | head -50
cat .eslintrc* 2>/dev/null || cat eslint.config.* 2>/dev/null || ls -la | grep -i eslint
find node_modules/@re-cinq -name "*.mjs" | xargs grep -l "spec-link\|validated by\|buildLinkIndex" 2>/dev/null | head -5
ls scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs 2>/dev/null && echo FOUND || echo NOT_FOUND
grep -n "thresholds\|coverage" vitest.config.ts 2>/dev/null || cat vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null | grep -n "thresholds\|coverage" | head -20

git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): resolve eslint and spec-link failures from CI

- add {cause: err} to registration Error (preserve-caught-error)
- reduce acceptance test expects from 5/3 to 1 each (max-expects)
- reduce unit test expects from 2 to 1 (max-expects)
- merge split spec-link parentheticals into single trailing paren
  so registry.test.ts#L4 is covered by require-spec-link
- update stale #L anchors to match acceptance test lines (40→48, 68→78)
- change spec status Draft→Shipped (all 5 statements linked)
- add CHANGELOG entry for tool input validation feature
- tick remaining dod facets (function-valued + static schema)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git status
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
